notes.topic: Lv 30 weapons not in shops at launch
notes.text: MeowDB item pages say Lv 30 weapons (Scimitar, Mithril Wand, Adamantium Guards, Ryden, Jousting Helmet) were removed from Perion/Ellinia/Henesys/Kerning shops; the only listed NPCs are in Orbis/El Nath, which aren't open yet. At Lv 30, get them by crafting or the Free Market, or keep the Lv 25 shop item.
None of the launch weapon/armor shop lists include gloves; early gloves come from crafting (Smithing/Tailoring/Leatherworking) or drops.
NPC prices are MeowDB 'launch prices' taken from community shop videos reviewed 2026-10-09; the pages don't say outright whether they were recorded on live or test servers.

MeowDB Free Market snapshot (2026-10-28): Two-Handed Sword ~7,000 (below NPC 13,500), clean Pan Lid 95,000, clean Red Viper 80,000, Overall Armor STR Scroll: Lesser ~87,888, Staff Magic Attack Scroll: Intermediate 75,000, Blue Arten gloves 39,999 (falling). Per-item FM prices on item pages were still loading, so most items have no market estimate.

Bowman and Thief guides favour Gloves Attack Scroll: Lesser (ID 118) over Crit Rate (ID 119); Magicians should use Gloves Magic Attack, since W.ATK scrolls do nothing for spells. The Lv 36 quest 'Collecting 150 Cursed Dolls' gives an Intermediate Gloves Attack or Gloves Magic Attack scroll (50/50).

Overall stat scrolls: Lesser is +1 at 100%, Intermediate +2 at 60%. Wand/Staff M.ATK Lesser costs 60,000 from El Moth; Overall INT Lesser costs 40,000 from Ben (Kerning, Distinguished Citizen); Shield DEF Lesser costs 20,000 from Tulcus. Sauna Robes (10 slots) are the main overall target.
Rowen's 'Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls' (Lv 36) gives a Lv 40 hat by class: Steel Nordic Helm (warrior), Dark Guiltian (mage), Dark Distinction (bowman), Dark Pilfer (thief).

The MeowDB 1-30 guides list weapons and armor by level but rarely call anything 'best' or 'budget'. Tiers here are inferred: bis = highest stats the guide lists for that level, affordable = cheaper or alternative option the guide mentions, accessible = NPC shop or quest item. Picks marked 'Not a guide recommendation' come only from shop lists.
